{"audioWeight":0.65,"callBackUrl":"https://example.com/cb","customMode":true,"duration":255,"instrumental":false,"model":"V6","negativeTags":"female lead vocals, party rap, trap hi-hats, autotune, EDM drop, comedy, saxophone, reggaeton","prompt":"[Intro: lonely piano figure, vinyl crackle, spoken low]
Say you get one take. One.
No edit. No undo.
You going to flinch, or you going to roll?

[Verse 1: male rap, tense, palm-muted guitar chug begins]
There's coffee on the collar of the only shirt he ironed
Forty-three years old with a resume retired
He rehearsed it in the mirror, in the shower, in the car
But the lobby's made of marble and he's forgotten who they are
The names, the game, the fifteen bullet points
His knee is bouncing double-time, he's cracking all his joints
The clock above reception says he's nineteen minutes early
There's a kid across the carpet looking brand new and unhurried
Half his age and twice his calm, scrolling like he's bored
While he's sweating through the lining, saying "steady" to the floor
He thinks about the mortgage, thinks about his daughter
Who believes he hung the moon and walked across the water
Door opens, "we're ready," and the hallway starts to tilt
Everything he ever was is everything he built
One breath, pick it up, there's no rerun of this scene
So he stands

[Chorus: sung-shouted, big drums, strings and guitars]
One take, roll it
No cut, no second pass
The red light's on, so hold it
Steady, make it last
One take, that's all there is
Say it like you mean to stay
Nobody hands you one take twice
So don't you look away

[Verse 2: male rap, first person now, faster]
They ask about the gap and I can feel the ceiling pressing
I could give them the rehearsed one, the buzzwords and the dressing
Instead I hear my mouth say, "I was home, my dad was dying
I learned more in that one year than in twenty years of trying"
Silence. Then the one on the left puts down her pen
Says "tell me more about it," and I'm breathing again
Funny how the truth was the only thing I never practised
All that polish on the surface and the real thing was the fastest
Now my hands have quit their shaking and my voice has found its floor
I'm not asking for a favour, I know what I'm good for
If it's yes then it's a yes, if it's no then it's a no
But I said it like I meant it, and I'm ready, so

[Chorus: sung-shouted, big drums, strings and guitars]
One take, roll it
No cut, no second pass
The red light's on, so hold it
Steady, make it last
One take, that's all there is
Say it like you mean to stay
Nobody hands you one take twice
So don't you look away

[Verse 3: male rap, calmer, drums drop to kick and piano]
This is for the late shift, the last chance, the long shot
The ones who got the callback when they figured they would not
It was never now or never, that's a line they sell the young
It's now, and then it's later, and then another one
But every single one of them, you only get it once
So roll

[Final Chorus: full band, choir pad, ad-libs]
One take, roll it
No cut, no second pass
The red light's on, so hold it
Steady, make it last

[Outro: piano figure alone, a door closing]","style":"2002 cinematic rap rock, male rapper with a sharp precise slightly nasal delivery and dense internal rhymes, gritty half-sung half-shouted doubled hook, 86 BPM, D minor, tense and coiled, lonely detuned piano intro with spoken lines, palm-muted electric guitar chugging eighth notes throughout, cinematic strings, hard simple drums with heavy kick and slamming snare, deep bass, soft choir pad in the last chorus, dry close vocal, loud punchy mix, determined, urgent, motivational","styleWeight":0.65,"title":"One Take","variety":0,"vocalGender":"m","weirdnessConstraint":0.5}
